name: duel
_comment: Wave 12 item 1, the 'Fight to be Thurokiir' replica in Kit FF Range. The spaceport offer places an anchored Kit Duellist shooter (gövt 355, ShipBehav 0) 260 px north; the Mission BBS job (mïsn 1052: ShipGoal 1 'disable but don't destroy', ShipBehav 0, OnSuccess b9101, OnFailure b9102) places the duellist (magenta pointer, shield 200 / armor 1500, anchored) 110 px north, on the shooter's line of fire at the player (Kit Ring Tank + Kit Duel Gun, 100-damage turret). Record from Leave; click the duellist; tap the gun until the panel reads Disabled; watch 40 s (do the shooter's bolts / blasts aimed at the player now stop on the DISABLED same-govt duellist, and does its death fail the mission?); then the player fires until it is gone (does the player's kill of a ship he disabled fail it?); the mission list; land, read any dialog, leave; pull (b9101 / b9102). Pilots w12_duel_bolt (Kit FF Shooter, 10-damage bolt), w12_duel_blast (Kit Duel Shooter Blast, 100 damage, 150 px blast).
